# active_config { #crossrepo.config.active_config }

```python
crossrepo.config.active_config()
```

The settings in effect for calls that are not given any.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Config](`crossrepo.config.Config`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The settings registered with [](`crossrepo.config.use_config`), or, while none is registered, the ones read from [](`crossrepo.config.config_path`). Every function taking a ``cfg`` argument falls back to this when it is left out, so this says what such a call is about to use.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
crossrepo.active_config().owners
```
